messages:
Ria: Kicking off a quick thread to align on Snowflake Delta Share + Databricks Unity Catalog + Qdrant connector packaging for marketplace listing. Goal: single onboarding playbook + CI checks.
Tom: Nice. Primary risks I see: Delta Share ACLs, Unity Catalog permission model, Qdrant index schema mismatches.
Jade: For listing we also need a short demo flow that shows ingest -> vectorize -> nearest-neighbor search with filters (time/customer_id). Marketing wants a 2-min video.
Marta: Legal note: if demo uses sampled customer data, ensure masking + attestations. I'll handle the checklist.
Ria: Proposed mini-timeline:
- Day 0: confirm partner PMs + logo/asset approvals
- Day 2: push sample dataset (masked) to partner-test bucket
- Day 4: CI scenario: delta-share ingest -> transform -> upsert to Qdrant index
- Day 7: infra soak + perf matrix (latency @ 1k qps, tail p99)
- Day 10: embargo lock and joint dry-run
Tom: Infra asks: provide a reproducible GitHub Action workflow. Suggest we include a feature-flagged path to flip between pinq (Qdrant) and milvus for comparison.
Jade: I'll draft the demo script. Can we avoid hard latency claims until perf is stable? Marketing agrees.
PM Bot: Reminder: request for partner logo approvals sent to Snowflake and Qdrant at 2025-06-02T15:00Z. Status: pending.
Marta: Legal will deliver the data usage blurb and EU residency check by 2025-06-04 EOD.
Tom: Infra plan: I'll run the CI job with Unity Catalog sandbox and Delta Share consumer creds. Using Qdrant 1.2.3 in staging. Posting action yml here once ready. ETA 48h after sample dataset.
Jade: Also need SSO test with Databricks workspace tokens for the demo. I can coordinate with partner PM.
Ria: Decision point: combined marketplace bundle vs Redwood listing + "Certified Connector" badge. Pros/cons?
Marta: Combined bundle triggers additional contract and revenue share review. My vote: start with Redwood listing + certified-badge to speed to market.
Tom: Agreed. Ops/infra prefers faster release cadence. We can revisit bundling after initial traction.
Jade: Action items:
- Jade: demo script + 2-min video storyboard (due +3d)
- Tom: CI GH Action + soak plan (due +2d)
- Marta: legal checklist + EU residency (due +2d)
- Ria: partner PM outreach + logo approvals (due +1d)
PM Bot: Action item created: "qdrant-delta-orch" assigned to Ria, due 2025-06-05T23:59:00Z.
InfraBot: CI job scheduled: connectors/cicd/delta-qdrant-integration. Will post artifacts to build-archive on failure.
Tom: One technical note: Qdrant needs explicit payload schema for metadata filters; ensure our vectorizer writes the same column names as the preview. I'll add a schema migration check in CI.
Jade: I'll make the demo avoid any schema-mismatch by using a thin adapter in the demo repo.
Ria: If everyone is ok, I'll fold this into the master triage doc and loop partner PMs. Quick sync Thurs 9am PT.
Marta: No objections. Add rollback: unpublish listing + feature-flag off + emergency support channel.
Jade: Thanks all.
Ria: End thread.
